svg.title: Orion Powers — Software Engineer
svg.desc: Orion the Hunter: raised arm, curved bow, shoulders, three-star belt and feet, plotted from real stellar coordinates in a dark night sky. Orange Betelgeuse marks the upper left shoulder and blue-white Rigel the lower right foot. Orion Powers: applied AI, production applications, and systems.

g.text: FLORIDA TECH · B.S. COMPUTER SCIENCE · DEC 2026
